subtitle: Finds drops, restocks & deals
promotionalText: Holiday hunting is on: your AI scouts are finding gifts, restocks and deals right now.
reviewNotes: Sign in: tap 'Continue with email', then 'Sign in', and use the demo account below. The account has three scouts with real finds. Baget Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly) on the Pro screen, reachable from Settings > Go Pro.
whatsNew:
What's new in 1.3
• Product photos show up instantly instead of loading in.
• A clearer name in the App Store: Baget, your AI personal shopper.
name: Baget: AI Personal Shopper
